rows.title: CPU/RSS economics
rows.delivery: Merged read/source increments through [#83](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/83); replay [#84](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/84) open includes a921c10 qualification reduction and linked-log index.
rows.limits: Cold <30 s, complete-monitor idle <5%, endpoint p95 <100 ms and final combined memory/WAL acceptance remain open. Endpoint/call-count results do not prove whole-monitor improvement.
rows.evidence: Controlled reports retain workload/source boundaries; see the separate resource ledger below.

rows.title: No default retention
rows.limits: New managed stores use a 14-day age policy; existing stores require explicit opt-in. Age retention is not a byte cap, immediate file shrink or proof of a memory/WAL plateau.

rows.title: Telemetry in the launch directory
rows.limits: Private XDG state and explicit non-destructive legacy migration are provided. Explicit --db remains an intentional user override; captured content is still sensitive.

rows.title: Unreliable one-shot scripting
rows.limits: Readiness/error/partial/interrupt are distinguished; missing data is not a zero-success snapshot. Discovery/readiness can exceed the deadline and return partial rather than pretend success.

rows.title: OpenCode step mistaken for turn
rows.limits: Recorded user-parent membership joins prompt and assistant/tool steps; exact-step mode remains explicit. Missing/contradictory membership stays unknown; no time-proximity join.

rows.title: Codex Review omits real evidence
rows.limits: Native-shaped ingestion→Store→authenticated API→Review/export assertions cover edits/checks/text/usage. This is not universal producer-version compatibility; F26 provenance remains qualified.

rows.title: Noisy attention signal
rows.limits: Explicit request/unknown separation and incident identity are present. Advisory stalled/failed states are not native approval authority; unsupported clocks/coverage defer reliable delivery.

rows.title: Low roster/Overview information density
rows.limits: Compact/expanded inspectors show recorded paths/checks/issues before assistant claims; hierarchy/shading/keyboard behavior retained. Loaded bounded evidence is not a full-history summary.

rows.title: Old completion backlog
rows.delivery: Merged [#67](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/67) / [#70](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/70); same receipts used by open [#82](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/82).
rows.limits: Today/history, human-readable ages and frozen-ID bulk review exist. Marking reviewed is neither native approval nor proof of resolution; old archived records remain inspectable.

rows.title: No observed continuity adoption
rows.delivery: Technical drafts merged [#77](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/77); pilot materials in merged [#80](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/80).
rows.limits: No new participant, author-use or voluntary repeat-use observation is established. Pilot denominator is 0 participants / 0 sessions / 0 repeat-use observations; do not infer adoption from tests.

rows.title: Shared daemon falsely proves progress
rows.limits: Multiplexed/app-server activity is not per-session progress; unconfirmed status remains possible. Linux process evidence and the generated soak do not cover every runtime/platform.

rows.title: Unknown children counted as actionable
rows.limits: Unknown/unlinked coverage is separated from explicit requests. New collision/loop/native heuristics must not silently turn it into an approval request.

rows.title: Strong MCP screen lacks qualified recommendations
rows.status: Implemented visible branch; new-head CI pending
rows.limits: Selected-tool loaded-page outcome/duration denominators, small samples, actual configured-server unobserved context and keyboard flagged-call navigation are visible and tested. No response-correctness, all-history reliability or tool-deletion conclusion follows. Corrected PR81 head still needs full CI and merge.

rows.title: Generic failures without useful evidence
rows.delivery: Merged [#75](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/75) / [#76](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/76); local `a921c10` preserves references while reducing repeated parsing.
rows.limits: Commands/exits/output roles, occurrence ownership, safe fingerprints and exact sources are implemented. Unknown/redacted/clipped inputs cannot prove equivalence; a later success does not prove complete repair.

rows.title: Historical JSON expansion/read cost
rows.limits: Indexed Activity/scalar rollups and bounded source reads replace repeated full-history Activity expansion. Remaining retained MCP grouping, cold migration and combined monitor cost are material and not closed.

rows.title: Local API/privacy/redaction defaults
rows.limits: Private token/Host/Origin/redirect checks, expanded best-effort redaction and late-egress capture fences exist. No universal secret-detection or security guarantee follows; new paths still need combined-source gates.

rows.title: Native add/update edits discarded
rows.delivery: Native actions merged [#67](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/67) / [#75](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/75); typed rename integration in merged [#80](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/80).
rows.limits: Failed/unknown file attempts do not prove a persisted change. Both explicit rename paths survive typed argument projection in G; no arrow/path equivalence guessing.

rows.title: Wrapped native checks not recognized
rows.limits: Recognized wrappers/qualified compound success are supported; no-op, masked, unknown or ambiguous failure remains unverified. Recorded success does not certify later worktree changes.

rows.title: Exact usage rejected or misallocated
rows.status: Implemented allocation and scope labels; CI pending
rows.limits: Single-owner/turn usage, unknown fields and partial costs are preserved. R8 label/selection work is separate from accounting; no shared-trace allocation or zero from missing data.

rows.title: Assistant-message placeholders
rows.limits: Supported native text blocks reach Review and generic placeholders are suppressed. New upstream schemas and live Claude/Pi compatibility are not proven by these synthetic contracts.

rows.title: Initiating request crowded out
rows.limits: Independent request/update context and paging expose intent within explicit source limits. Pruned, uncaptured or clipped intent remains unavailable, never reconstructed by guesswork.

rows.title: Complete captured run shows zero work
rows.limits: End-to-end native-shaped checks/edits/text/usage and generated reconstructions are verified. Coverage limits and unsupported producer variants remain explicit; tests are not current live participant evidence.

rows.title: Review JSON/task-link mismatch
rows.limits: Raw Review JSON composes without retyping IDs; turn members/check source traces/accounting survive. Contradictory links reject; legacy ambiguous data stays readable without trusted totals until explicit repair.

rows.title: Passing suite hid fixture mismatch
rows.delivery: Main through [#79](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/79) merged; merged [#80](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/80)–[#83](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/83) have separate CI states.
rows.limits: Counts alone do not close fidelity. PR80 and PR83 are merged with all 12 checks green. Corrected E/F heads have focused gates and independent review, but their new full CI and final combined-tree packaging/security/ownership/capture/terminal checks remain delivery gates.

rows.title: OpenCode prompts excluded by trace
rows.limits: Whole-turn scope uses recorded membership and includes the initiating prompt. Exact-step mode can intentionally omit other steps; absent parent/turn evidence is not invented.

rows.title: Idealized rather than version-labelled goldens
rows.delivery: Native-shaped tests merged [#67](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/67); G pilot/search in merged [#80](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/80).
rows.limits: Repository-native synthetic contracts are tested, but upstream producer/schema versions were not recorded for these fixtures. A truthful provenance manifest records unknown rather than assigning installed versions. Live Claude/Pi and future-version compatibility remain open.

rows.title: Cockpit-bound delivery, native events and Git
rows.limits: Authenticated watcher/shared claims and optional native metadata work without a cockpit. Original CI exposed a headless Review crash and duplicate Activity traversal; corrected PR82 restores both and passes authenticated CLI, exact-400-visits, cache, capture and actual Review parity gates. Full new-head CI/merge remains pending. Actual desktop delivery is mocked; supported runtime request IDs/order/capacity/clock limits remain.

rows.title: Reliable cross-runtime attention
rows.limits: Use agenturm attention watch against an existing authenticated receiver. Quiet baseline, offline eligible requests, durable dedup and corrected Review/source-pass parity are tested. PR82 new-head CI/merge remains pending; native approval remains manual. Mocked delivery is not measured alert precision or live OS delivery.

rows.title: Truthful per-turn receipts with frozen Git
rows.limits: Review g/m explicitly maps/captures read-only Git; earlier checks do not certify the current checkout. Recorded edits and all worktree changes/pre-existing/concurrent work stay distinct.

rows.title: Actionable failure diagnosis
rows.limits: Current/previous unseen reminders remain separate from archival Findings. Exact source s/container trace t, expected nonzero and later-success evidence retain source scope; no repaired-task conclusion.

rows.title: Approved automatic continuity
rows.limits: Review d prepares source-backed editable text, then explicit approval appends an immutable version. Human title/notes/brief/decisions are not overwritten; no human decision or intent is invented.

rows.title: Parallel-work overlap awareness
rows.delivery: Merged [#77](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/77); typed rename pair fidelity in merged [#80](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/80).
rows.limits: Explicit mapped checkouts/recorded paths and strict check-before-other-edit chronology are shown. Historical branch identity often remains unverified; unknown overlap is not collision proof. Different worktrees, failed attempts and ambiguous paths do not become confirmed collisions.

rows.title: Progression and repeated-work evidence
rows.status: Implemented opt-in branch; new-head CI pending
rows.delivery: Corrected open [#81](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/81) head 928cae0 includes the delivered progression patch, source-complete Store hook and legacy-cache repair.
rows.limits: Opt in via AGENTURM_WORKFLOW_PATTERNS=1. Later matching success includes failed and successful sources. Repetition observations may attach strictly timed leaf-model reported contributions only with complete exact owner/execution/source proof. Actual Store publication and resumable workflow_patterns_v2 repair are tested; unknown/partial input remains unavailable. No new always-on usage finding, waste/retry-cost attribution, cumulative delta or context-occupancy inference.

rows.title: Qualified MCP recommendations
rows.status: Implemented visible branch; new-head CI pending
rows.limits: Current loaded-page outcome/duration denominators, small samples, configured-unobserved context and keyboard flagged-call navigation are wired in the existing MCP inspector. Exact receiver/capture checks remain. An observed protocol/tool success does not evaluate response correctness; absence never recommends deleting configuration.

rows.title: Usage scope, cache and optional estimates
rows.status: Implemented qualified windows; new-head CI pending
rows.delivery: Allocation merged; open [#81](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/81) carries explanations and scope follow-up.
rows.limits: Whole-turn ID/member-step labels are distinct from one trace. Exact-owner captured session lifetime is separate; exact-agent calendar-day data is explicitly unavailable. Retry cost and current occupancy remain unavailable without authoritative evidence. Exact-model explicit-rate estimates stay separate from recorded cost and require complete unambiguous allocation.

rows.title: Global retrospective investigations
rows.status: Implemented and merged; resource limits remain
rows.limits: Activity History / Ctrl+F / palette and `agenturm investigate` are wired. Typed retained path/command/instruction queries, bounded paging, FTS availability and pinned exact source reader are tested. No match proves no activity; old lookup/index-cost data excludes final combined-source overhead.

rows.title: Safe local collection defaults
rows.delivery: Merged [#67](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/67) / [#70](https://github.com/abhishekash/agenturm/pull/70); new open paths inherit invariants.
rows.limits: Private state/token, Host/Origin, best-effort redaction, capture fences and age retention exist. No all-secrets guarantee, hard disk cap or automatic purge of independently authored task content.

rows.title: Optional native lifecycle integration
rows.limits: Generic-v1 is explicit exact metadata; Codex notify adapter is completion-only with independently checked turns. Claude/Pi/OpenCode approval contracts without authoritative request/order mapping remain unsupported/uncertain. Installed version inspection is not live compatibility testing.
